hypothesis: Excess low-density braking anticipation creates false bottleneck congestion and suppresses paired control response.
law: For downstream>rho only, use denominator max(rho,beta*rho_crit)+kappa. Equivalent nu scaling; no capacity or command bonus.
training: seed29 common2220.1,450s none/vsl/rm/both; future observations used only for scores
response_score: Mean over three action-baseline pairs of squared deltaTTT error/(1veh*h)^2 + delta(total off+terminal departures) error/(20veh)^2 + delta actual merges error/(20veh)^2.
selection: Require >=20% response-score reduction and mean stock/flow RMSE no more than10% worse than current across four arms. Select lowest response score; stop if none passes.
qualification: Require meaningful actual gain/harm signs (abs deltaTTT>=0.25veh*h), improved paired score and stock/flow guards in both checks. Still not fullOmega, freeflow or unseen-seed qualification.
independence: Checks not used to choose beta, but previously examined states; not pristine holdouts.
